name: Mesopotamia
brief: The region between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers
short: Mesopotamia, the ancient region between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers, where Abraham lived before being called to Canaan (<ref="Genesis 24:10; Act.7.2">Genesis 24:10; Act.7.2</ref>) and where the Israelites were oppressed by Cushan-rishathaim (<ref="Judges 3:8">Judges 3:8, 10</ref>).
